other_seed_handoffs: All four policies reach next floor alive on all four cases, within 600 RC decisions; not next-floor clearance.

diagnostics.d7: Final model loses sight of white imp, receives +100, and hands back to RC; imp reappears by second RC decision. Subsequent fight ends with adjacent manticore, following vampire mosquito involvement.

limitations: One teaching checkpoint, four other-seed cases, one evaluation repeat each; previously studied seeds, not a pristine holdout.
Six training recoveries are proxy outcomes without training-time handoff audit, not six durable successes.
Initial imitation preserves the D7 success but RL fine-tuning regresses it; no general improvement established.
Need hazard safety overrides and delayed recovery credit tied to continuation before promoting a model.
